sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Morning debrief with night shift regarding early morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed, suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route. Arrived at check-in Corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. Welfare check, all clear:
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square, full sweep around the area, all clear.
Walkthrough Bledisloe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Center, all clear.
Welfare check Elliotstables, Elliott Street Apartment, Atrium on Elliott, Elliott Food Court, all clear.
Welfare check Tank, Domino's Pizza, Freshmarket Store, Tandoor, Ground Coffee, Hikoco, Wilson Carpark Food Stalls, Pizza Club Elliot St, all clear.
Welfare check Woolworths Victoria Street West, Kiwi Gift, Mr Katsu, City Liquour, Cinnamon Squared, Sana, Lord Nelson's Steak House, Scrunchy Miller's, all clear.
Welfare check Skymart Convenience Store, Mobile Doctor, Tattoo Shop, Studio 7, Surf n Snow Backpackers, all clear.
Welfare check Formery, Little Albert's Coffee, Barclay's Suites, Bespoke Coffee, Good To Go Supermarket, Natural Health Souvenirs, all clear.
Welfare check SVS Vape Shop, SCS Convenience Store, Taco Infusion Mexican Cuisine, Galata Kebab and Grill, Bistro Saine, Sumo Sushi, Shakespeare Tavern, all clear.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy and Vape Shop, Nola Coffee, Ichiiban Japanese Restaurant, all clear.
Welfare check Zibbetto Espresso Bar, Palmer Bar, Ronnies Cafe, Woolworths Lower Albert St, Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, full sweep around the area.
Response call from OPSM regarding a male individual lingering outside. Assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; the building fire alarm has gone off and everyone in the building has been moved outside.
Standing by until fire trucks and fire alarm have been cleared.
Fire alarm cleared, fire trucks leaving and tenants cleared to move back inside the building.
There is a long line from Noel Leeming all the way to Shortland Street — grand opening for Noel Leeming and a massive sale, 50% off.
Response call from Jess (HOTC) requesting we stand by due to an aggressive female individual screaming in public.
Approached the female individual and spoke to her, tried to calm her down.
After speaking with the female individual it appears she is going through a mental breakdown.

Standing by to show presence until the female leaves, and to maintain presence until the queue into Noel Leeming shortens; due to short security staff, vagrants lingering, and people trying to cut the queue, we will be standing by here for a while.
Leaving standby at Noel Leeming and commencing routes again.
Response call from Cotton On regarding a repeat offender in store from yesterday who tried taking $1k worth of items. Assistance requested.

Arrived at the response call and spoke to staff; offered the alternative of asking her to leave since she is a known repeat offender, but staff declined and requested we wait outside and will communicate if they need us to attend.
Standing by outside Cotton On awaiting orders from staff.
While standing by outside the premises the individual tried leaving the store. Stopped her and asked her to surrender the items she had stuffed down her pants.
Individual surrendered items and left the store. We did issue a trespass notice.
Returning to routes. Welfare check Vulcan Lane and stores within the vicinity, all clear.
Welfare check Partridge, Pandora, Queens Jewelry, Sail Away Souvenirs, Global Culture, Michael Hills.
Response call from management (Mark) requesting assistance to move equipment to level 7.
Items taken up to level 7. Returning to routes.
Response call from Noel Leeming regional manager requesting assistance dealing with an aggressive male individual with a guitar walking towards Britomart Square.
After scanning the area and the last seen direction, no signs of the individual.
Response call from Cotton On requiring an Auror report from 6 Sept. Will find it and send it through.
Welfare check Kathmandu, Macpac, Art Gallery, House of Haghi, Taco Bell, Shortland Street Convenience Store, BNZ Place, BNZ building entrance Shortland St, Partridge Jewelry, Pocket Park, all clear.
Welfare check Cartier, Quest, Western Union Money Exchange, Cookes, Fable, Q Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check Imperial Lane, building sweep.
Response call from an Albert St building that suspicious individuals are lingering outside the premises. Assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived and called back the number, but the individuals have left.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, all clear. Ending Alpha Route and commencing Echo Route.
Response call from Cotton On Queen Street regarding a female individual who stole items, last seen heading upper Queen Street.
Arrived at the response call; staff described her as tall, blonde, Polynesian/Maori, light yellow beige clothing.
After searching the area where she was last seen heading, no signs of the individual.
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square, all clear.
Welfare check Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Welfare check Airedale Suites Queen Street, Queens Food Court, Munster Inn, Nandos, all clear.
Lunch break completed, standing by for changeover to Afternoon shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing survey handouts while being vigilant and aware of any response calls.
Noticed a suspicious female and male vagrant walk into Cotton On; standing by in case they attempt to steal. While on standby, Cotton On staff informed us they might have put items into their bag.

Came into contact with the male and female vagrant at the exit of the store; searched both for stolen items, nothing was found on them. Standing by in case they return and keeping an eye on them from afar, last seen heading up Queen St. (photo on file)
Leaving standby area, no issues occurred.
Response call from Quest on Queen Hotel regarding a male being loud outside their premises. Assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at Quest on Queen, informed the male vagrant he had to move along due to the building manager's request; he was compliant, no issues to report. Standing by. (photo on file)
Response call from Gotcha High St regarding the same two male and female vagrants — they have stolen two wallets from the store, last seen heading towards Shortland St / Vulcan Lane.

Male and female vagrant spotted on Vulcan Lane; interacted with both regarding the two stolen wallets and successfully had both items handed over, no issues to report. Heading to Gotcha to return items.
Items have been successfully handed over to Gotcha staff members. (photo on file)
Arrived at Queen St, welfare check:
Welfare checks on the above stores all clear, none have anything to report. Maintaining presence on Queen St for any nearby response calls and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants.
Arrived at upper Queen St, commencing welfare checks:

Welfare checks on the above stores complete, none have anything to report. Standing by maintaining presence on upper Queen St for any nearby response calls and remaining vigilant to problematic issues or vagrants.
Response call from Mercury Hotel 500 Queen St regarding a male being verbally abusive towards members of the public outside their premises. Assistance requested to move him along.

Arrived at 500 Queen St; the male has moved along of his own will, no visual of him. Paramedics requested we stand by for presence due to an altercation that happened between members of the public and the patient they are dealing with. Standing by. (photo on file)
Leaving standby area, assistance no longer needed from paramedics.
Arrived at Aotea Sq, commencing a full sweep and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants.
Full sweep of Aotea Sq complete, no issues or problematic vagrants to report.
Arrived at Te Waihorotiu Train Station, standing by ensuring presence is known to customers and members of the public.
Leaving standby area, no issues occurred while on standby.
While leaving standby area, HOTC guards heard a lot of sirens heading towards Albert St.

Arrived at Durham St West off Albert St; located the fire department, informed by fire fighters that someone may have set off an alarm with a cigarette by accident. Standing by in case assistance is needed with the public or bystanders. (photo on file)
While on standby, noticed a male being verbally aggressive — not towards members of the public but self-willingly. Had a chat with him, asked him to calm down; he complied and moved along.
Long line at Noel Leeming, standing by maintaining security and ensuring presence for customers.
Arrived back at HQ for a quick toilet break followed by floor checks.
Floor checks complete, standing by HQ charging ops phone due to low percentage while remaining vigilant to any response calls.
Ops phone at 63%, enough to engage routes. Gearing up preparing for patrols.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane, welfare check Queens Ferry, The Occidental, Curries and Kebab, all clear. Standing by maintaining presence.
Response call from Mr Murdochs regarding a male vagrant refusing to leave their premises. Assistance requested to remove him from the premises.

Arrived at Mr Murdochs Fort St, informed the male vagrant he had to vacate the premises due to the manager's request; he complied and left, no issues to report. Standing by Mr Murdochs in case the POI returns.
Police presence on Fort St for the male we dealt with earlier on Durham St West. Standing by in case assistance is needed by law enforcement. (photo on file)
Law enforcement have left the area; shadowing the male POI for the safety of the public in case he decides to act up again.
Male has headed onto Beach Road, no issues occurred during shadowing of the male POI.
Welfare check Char Grill, Giapo, Sals Pizza, Siennas, The Mermaid, Auckland Harbour Suites, Kingmade Noodles, Soy Hotel, no issues reported.
Arrived at TK Square, welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Standing by maintaining presence and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby area, heading back to HQ for 30 min meal break, no issues occurred.
Arrived at HQ standing by, being vigilant to any response calls.
Standing by HQ for handover to Night shift, still being vigilant.
Afternoon shift concluded, handover to Night shift. Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Received a call from Britomart Maccas due to someone disturbing customers.
Arrived on site, police were there on standby. Showing security presence and available for any needed assistance.
No assistance needed, Maccas all clear, no further issues.
Full sweep Quay St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Commerce St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark, welfare checks Evans / KFC / White Lady, no issues to report. Heading up High St.
Full sweep High St / Freyberg / Chancery Sq / Kitchener St, all clear, no issues to report.
Whole of High Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling Lorne St.
Welfare check Lorne mural staircase and Radisson, all clear.
Whole of Lorne Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling to Aotea Square.
Welfare check Rutland Street, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep and making our presence visible in the area.
Currently still at Aotea Square sweeping the area.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues. Patrolling down Mayoral Drive.
Welfare check Mayoral Drive, patrolling Albert Street.
Welfare check Skymart Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Full sweep Albert Street, all clear. Patrolling Lower Albert.
Lower Albert Street all clear. Patrolling to Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; due to still much footwork in the area will maintain presence while sweeping.
Currently still at Britomart sweeping the area and showing presence.
Full sweep Britomart, welfare check on McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Customs Street.
Welfare check Customs Convenience Store, all clear.
Whole of Customs Street West all clear. Patrolling down Fort Street.
Full sweep Fort Street, welfare check Commerce St / Gore St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Fort Lane, all clear, no issues. Patrolling to High Street.
Response call to Queen St Maccas due to a group of people sleeping in the lobby.
Arrived on site, woke them up and kindly removed them from the premises.
Queen St Maccas all clear, no further issues.
Whole of Victoria Street, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, Skymart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Federal Street.
Whole of Federal Street all clear, no issues. Arrived at Federal Square commencing sweep.
Full sweep Federal, welfare check Cathedral, Liston House, no issues identified. Patrolling Wyndham Street.
Full sweep Wyndham Street all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street all clear. Arriving at McDonald's for welfare check.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens, all clear. Patrolling to Darby Street.
Welfare check Darby Street, all clear.
Welfare check Elliot carpark, all clear.
Full sweep Elliot Street, welfare checks all clear. Patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Sq commencing sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Rutland Street, all clear.
Top half of Lorne Street all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Lorne staircase mural, all clear, no issues.
Whole of Lorne Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling High Street.
Top half of High Street all clear. Arrived at Freyberg Pl commencing sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg Place, welfare check O'Connell Street, Chancery St, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
Whole of High Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling down to Fort Lane.
Full sweep Fort Lane, welfare check Shortland Street, Jean Batten Ave, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Fort Street.
Full sweep Fort Street, welfare check Commerce St, Gore St, Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Customs Street West.
Whole of Customs Street West all clear, no issues to report. Arriving at Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart commencing sweep and showing presence.
Currently still at Britomart sweeping the area and maintaining visible presence.
Full sweep Britomart, welfare check McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street, arrived at office commencing 30 minute break, charging the ops phone and responding to any calls.
30 minute break completed, standing by in office for guard handover.
Night shift concluded, handing over to morning shift.
